disposition_reason: Per-product element concentrations for 31 retail pink salts and one iodized white table salt control, plus summary statistics, from an ICP-MS scan.

study.origin: Himalayas (27), Australia (3), Peru (1) as labelled; control origin not stated
study.market: supermarkets, green grocers and health food shops in Sydney (NSW), Canberra (ACT) and Coffs Harbour (NSW), Australia
study.method: aqua regia hot-block digestion (120 °C, 1 h); ICP-MS (NexION 300D) mass spectrometry scan, single test per sample
study.qa: NATA-accredited laboratory; no CRM or recovery data reported
